body:
V2 UI item. Inbox tab. Quick filter buttons.

## Problem
The Inbox tab (/inbox) shows 354 items as one long list with a search box, a Kind dropdown and a State dropdown. The homeowner wants buttons that change the view in one click, with the counts visible, without typing.

## Requirements
1. A row of toggle buttons above the list, each showing its live count: Waiting for approval, Running, Done, Failed, Refused or rejected, All. Waiting for approval is the default view when anything is waiting, otherwise All.
2. A second row of buttons by kind (prompt, issue draft, action, control, decision) with counts, combinable with the state buttons.
3. The buttons set the same filters as the existing State and Kind dropdowns and stay in step with them; the search box still works on top of them.
4. The selected buttons are kept when the page refreshes and when the homeowner returns to the tab (saved per viewer, as the layout is in #927). An empty result says which filters are on and has a Clear filters button.
5. Counts come from the same data as the list. The 354 total must equal the sum of the state counts.
6. Phone width: buttons wrap, each tap target at least 44 px, no sideways scroll.
7. Built on the shared list component from #939 where it fits; the filter logic lives in its own module, not in dashrender.mjs, team.mjs or dashserver.mjs.

## Acceptance
- before PR: unit tests for the filter module: each state button, each kind button, both combined, search on top, an empty result, and the counts summing to the total.
- before PR: Playwright browser test at desktop 1280 and phone 390 against a fixture inbox that copies the real shape: one prompt done (title "Rules drift check read only Driftcheck", state done), one issue_draft done ("Post-mortem: 3 jobs failed with cause deterministic"), one waiting proposal, one failed prompt. Clicks Waiting for approval and sees only the waiting item; clicks Failed and sees only the failed item; reloads and the choice is kept; clicks Clear filters.
- before PR: the test drives the real /inbox page entry point, not a direct call to the filter module.
- after install: Live checks below.
- before PR: docs/dashboard.md updated.

## Live checks
- GET /inbox -> 200 contains "Inbox"

## Requirements check
One row per numbered requirement above. Every row Met with file, line and the test that proves it.

## Follow-ups carried
None carried. Answer slot: if a review follow-up is raised against this item, answer it with a change, a decision or a stated reason.
